REQ-030.design_rationale: Section 2.1 details the exact regex and logic in scripts/enforce-delegation.py (normalize_command_signature) ensuring python -c commands only normalize to POLL_FILE:<path> when direct read/tail one-liners are used without file writes or analytical/control-flow constructs (import re, import json, import xml, import ast, import difflib, re., json., difflib., ET., def , for ... in). Section 2.2 specifies the identical implementation in dsh-attention-guard-plugin/src/circuit-breaker.ts (normalizeCommandSignature), and Section 2.3 defines regression test criteria.
REQ-030.tasks_rationale: Task 1 implements TDD regression tests and normalizer logic in scripts/enforce-delegation.py. Task 2 implements corresponding tests and logic in dsh-attention-guard-plugin/src/circuit-breaker.ts. Task 3 runs test suites and documents verification in verification.md.
REQ-030.debate_rationale: ADR-001 directly addresses telemetry-verified false positives (20 PRIMARY_TOOL_DENIED blocks across 8 conversations) where directory Path(...) references and distinct analytical queries on >500-line files were falsely collapsed into POLL_FILE. Requiring direct method chaining without analytical imports or loop constructs preserves log-polling circuit breaking while eliminating false-positive blocks on multi-file verification and AST-gate bypass analysis scripts.
REQ-030.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 2.1 cites test_req030_inline_python_analytical_scripts_not_collapsed_to_poll_file in tests/test_ledger_performance.py (PASSED) and full test suite execution (192 passed). Section 2.2 cites circuit-breaker.spec.ts passing under vitest (23 tests, 72 total in dsh-attention-guard-plugin), along with clean typecheck (tsc --noEmit) and build (tsc), confirming that direct one-liners continue to normalize to POLL_FILE while multi-line analytical scripts retain distinct signatures without false-positive blocks.
